title.value: Application of AI in community based primary health care: Systematic Review and critical appraisal
title.justification: The title succinctly captures the paper's objective, which is to review and critically assess the application of AI within community-based primary health care contexts.
title.quote: Application of AI in community based primary health care: Systematic Review and critical appraisal

extractions.description: This paper conducts a systematic scoping review to identify and evaluate studies involving AI interventions in community-based primary health care. It focuses on examining the AI methods used, such as machine learning and natural language processing, and their applications, such as diagnosis and surveillance in the healthcare context.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily reviews AI applications in healthcare, which is indirectly related to sustainable development if considered within the broader category of improving health systems. However, it does not directly focus on climate or ecological sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Despite the potential benefits and risks, we know little about the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into community based primary health care (CBPHC).

primary_category.justification: The paper's focus on AI in primary healthcare does not directly align with any specific Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development category. The content is more related to healthcare systems which is outside the scope of the specified categories relating to climate and ecological impacts.
primary_category.quote: We included all studies about AI interventions, that were implemented or tested with participants who were either CBPHC health providers or recipients.

primary_sub_category.justification: Given that the primary focus of the paper is on applications of AI in community-based healthcare rather than directly addressing any climate or ecological issues, there is no applicable sub-category.
primary_sub_category.quote: The AI systems were primarily tested and/or implemented for diagnosis, detection or surveillance purposes.

applications.justification: The paper discusses various AI interventions such as machine learning, NLP, and expert systems applied in community-based primary health care, focusing on diagnosis, detection, and surveillance.
applications.quote: Machine learning (46%), natural language processing (NLP) (27%) and expert systems (19%) were the most highly AI interventions studied in CBPHC. The AI systems were primarily tested and/or implemented for diagnosis, detection or surveillance purposes.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper does not introduce a new type of sustainable development category; it focuses on AI in healthcare, which is not within the climate or ecological sustainable development domains defined in the existing categories.
new_primary_category.quote: We conduced a a systematic scoping review... on... AI interventions... with participants who were either CBPHC health providers or recipients.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: As the primary theme of the paper pertains to healthcare AI applications, there is no necessity to propose a new sub-category since this does not align with environmental sustainability topics.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: Outcomes of interest had to be related to patients, health care providers and CBPHC systems.
